messages:
Marta (Comms): Heads up — final draft for internal release blurb below. Planning a 3pm PT change window today. Can someone quickly sanity-check and sign off?

Marta (Comms): DRAFT: ‘Today at 3pm PT we’ll roll v2.1.4 of the inference runtime. This release improves batching heuristics (lower cost per-token) and fixes a rare KV cache miss. Expect a short canary then wider rollout; teams with pinned model variants will not be affected. If you see increased errors, we’ll rollback to v2.1.3.’

Kai (Docs): looks solid. tiny nit: change “will not be affected” -> “should not be affected (unless pinned to experimental)”. add a short bullet for rollback procedure?

Marta (Comms): good call. adding rollback line: ‘Rollback: ops will revert inference runtime to tag v2.1.3 within the change window if error > 2% for 10m.’

Liam (Eng): FYI canary plan: 5% traffic for 15m, health checks include 5xx rate, latency p95, and quality regression probe. If any check trips we auto-fallback to v2.1.3 and notify #incidents. Pinning note: please confirm any product pins to v2.1.3 — those will remain on the older runtime unless changed manually.

June (PM): product pins: search shows mobile-ab tests pinned to v2.1.3 and billing-worker pinned to latest; I've DM'd owners to confirm. If we need to override pins for this release, we need a change request by 2:20pm PT.

Marta (Comms): @Liam can you paste the exact deploy-bot command we should use so comms can include it in the ops blurb?

Liam (Eng): deploy-bot: schedule --env prod --tag v2.1.4 --canary 5 --duration 15m --checks "5xx>2%|latency.p95>1.5s|quality-regression"

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window scheduled 2026-03-20 15:00-15:30 PT. Channel #eng-releases will receive deploy status.

Kai (Docs): small wording tweak for the blurb: replace “short canary then wider rollout” with “staged canary followed by progressive rollout (target 100% over ~45m)”. keeps expectations clearer.

Liam (Eng): ack to wording. Also adding a note for fallbacks: fallback lanes are: 1) region-level rollback, 2) model-variant fallback to quantized variant, 3) full runtime rollback to v2.1.3. Ops team picks lane depending on failure domain.

Marta (Comms): Updated DRAFT: ‘Today at 3pm PT we’ll roll v2.1.4 of the inference runtime. This release improves batching heuristics and fixes a KV cache miss. Deployment plan: staged canary (5% for 15m) then progressive rollout to 100% (~45m). Rollback: ops will revert to v2.1.3 if error >2% for 10m; fallback lanes may be applied per region. Pinned variants remain unchanged unless owners request an override. Contact #incidents for issues.’

June (PM): Approved from product side. owners notified for pins; waiting on one response for mobile-ab.

Kai (Docs): I approve copy. recommend we include the deploy-bot line in the internal note and the exact rollback tag.

Liam (Eng): ops: ready for schedule? ops-bot should get the schedule command ~10m before window.

ops-bot: deploy-bot queued for 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z (3:00pm PT). To execute run: `deploy-bot run 2161239999`

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for tag v2.1.4 at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z. Monitor: #eng-releases and #incidents.

Marta (Comms): Great — finalizing internal announcement now. Will post in #general and pin to #eng-releases. I'll include deploy-bot command and rollback tag. Thanks team :tada:

Liam (Eng): one more: if we see a quality regression that's borderline (0.8%-1.5%), let's do manual hold and run expanded evals before deciding rollback. I'll be on-call during window.

Marta (Comms): noted — will add: ‘manual hold possible for borderline regressions; eng on-call will triage.’

June (PM): All set from my side. lock the blurb and send when deploy-bot posts start.

Marta (Comms): sending in 5. posting now.
